flags.question: What is the total paid media budget for Meta and TikTok, and how should it split between English and French Canada?
flags.why: The brief gives no budget. The media plan (MED-1, due 6 Nov) and the 20,000 trial-start target depend on it.

flags.question: What is the signed budget for the five launch-week creators, and can it be signed by early November?
flags.why: Organic cannot start outreach without a signed budget, and contracts must be signed by 13 Nov (ORG-3) to meet the 15 working day lead time before launch-week content.

flags.question: Who is the native Quebec French reviewer for ads, store listings, the press release and creator content, the client or an agency supplier?
flags.why: L23 requires the review on all French copy. CRE-3, CRE-4 and the French store listing depend on that person being booked from mid November.

flags.question: Can client legal commit to a 2 working day turnaround on ads, store creatives, the press release and creator content between 13 Nov and 1 Dec?
flags.why: CRE-2, PR-1, CRE-4 and CRE-3 all need client legal approval in a tight window that includes US Thanksgiving closures. Slower reviews push paid go-live.

flags.question: Should Apple Search Ads and Google App Campaigns be in scope, or is paid acquisition limited to Meta and TikTok as the brief says?
flags.why: Media is scoped to Meta and TikTok only. Adding store search channels changes the media plan (MED-1) and budget split.

flags.question: Should a UA manager check pacing on the weekends of 12 to 13 and 19 to 20 Dec, or is working-day pacing with automated spend caps enough for the first two weeks?
flags.why: MED-7 daily pacing only covers working days. Weekend cover needs staff rostered, or else automated rules and caps must be set before go-live in MED-6.

flags.question: Who is Orbit Fitness's launch spokesperson for the release quote and briefings, and can they (or a second spokesperson) brief Quebec media in French?
flags.why: The quote in PR-2 is due 9 Nov, and briefings (PR-5, PR-6) run 20 Nov to 1 Dec. Without a French-speaking spokesperson, Quebec briefings need an interpreter or written Q&A instead.

flags.question: Can the client approve the 3 ad concepts within 1 working day (present 9 Nov, approve 10 Nov) and give one consolidated round of feedback per video edit round?
flags.why: English finals by 19 Nov only fit two 3-day edit rounds if concepts are approved by 10 Nov. Slower approval pushes CRE-2 and the French chain (CRE-7, CRE-3) past their milestones.

flags.question: How should the five launch-week creators split between English and French (Quebec) audiences? The plan assumes at least two French-language creators.
flags.why: The shortlist (ORG-4, due 27 Oct), outreach and contracts (ORG-3, due 13 Nov), and how much Quebec French review the briefs and drafts need all depend on this split.

flags.question: Should the wrap report judge 30% trial-to-paid on every trial started in the first 30 days (final read about 21 Jan 2027), or on an earlier partial cohort so the wrap lands around 8 Jan?
flags.why: With a 14-day trial, trials from day 30 only convert around 21 Jan. DAT-8 timing and how the KPI is defined both depend on this.

flags.question: When will Orbit's app team deliver the 1.0 SDK build with the agreed events (needed by about 13 Nov) and the store-ready iOS and Android binaries (needed by 23 Nov for submission on 24 Nov)?
flags.why: F2: DAT-3 MMP and SKAN setup, DAT-1 QA and ORG-2 app review submission all depend on these builds. A late build pushes the joint 8 Dec launch and MED-6.

flags.question: Can the native Quebec French reviewer (Q3) be named by 30 Oct? They are needed first for ORG-1 FR keywords by 6 Nov, PR-4 by 12 Nov and CRE-9 store assets from 13 Nov.
flags.why: F7: Q3 was only tied to late tasks. ORG-1, PR-4 and CRE-9 need the reviewer earlier, and a late answer puts the 6 Nov and 20 Nov milestones at risk.

assignments.scope: Paid social app install campaigns on Meta and TikTok in English and French for Canada, live on launch day 8 Dec. Creator partnerships: shortlist five fitness creators with English and French coverage, get the creator budget signed before any outreach, contracts signed by 13 Nov (ORG-3), briefs aligned with the ad concepts and launch messaging, client legal approval of content before posting, and #ad or paid-partnership disclosure on every post in launch week. French listing and creator copy reviewed by a native Quebec French speaker. No medical or weight-loss claims. Use trackable creator links from Data.

Measurement plan with trial start and trial-to-paid conversion events, event taxonomy signed off by the client, MMP configuration, SKAN conversion values and test installs on iOS and Android, all live and QA'd by 1 Dec (DAT-1), five working days before paid goes live. Tracking links for Media, creators and store listings. Daily dashboard live on launch day 8 Dec with installs, CPI, trial starts, trial-to-paid and D7 retention split by language and platform (from MED-1), daily through launch week, then weekly Monday reports and a wrap report against both KPIs (20,000 trials in 30 days, 30% trial-to-paid). Note the 14-day trial means conversion can only be read from around 22 Dec.

flags.question: What is the total paid media budget for Meta and TikTok, and how should it split between English and French Canada?
flags.why: The brief gives no budget. The media plan (MED-1, due 6 Nov) and the 20,000 trial-start target depend on it.

flags.question: What is the signed budget for the five launch-week creators, and can it be signed by early November?
flags.why: Organic cannot start outreach without a signed budget, and contracts must be signed by 13 Nov (ORG-3) to meet the 15 working day lead time before launch-week content.

flags.question: Who is the native Quebec French reviewer for ads, store listings, the press release and creator content, the client or an agency supplier?
flags.why: L23 requires the review on all French copy. CRE-3, CRE-4 and the French store listing depend on that person being booked from mid November.

flags.question: Can client legal commit to a 2 working day turnaround on ads, store creatives, the press release and creator content between 13 Nov and 1 Dec?
flags.why: CRE-2, PR-1, CRE-4 and CRE-3 all need client legal approval in a tight window that includes US Thanksgiving closures. Slower reviews push paid go-live.

flags.question: Should Apple Search Ads and Google App Campaigns be in scope, or is paid acquisition limited to Meta and TikTok as the brief says?
flags.why: Media is scoped to Meta and TikTok only. Adding store search channels changes the media plan (MED-1) and budget split.

flags.question: Should a UA manager check pacing on the weekends of 12 to 13 and 19 to 20 Dec, or is working-day pacing with automated spend caps enough for the first two weeks?
flags.why: MED-7 daily pacing only covers working days. Weekend cover needs staff rostered, or else automated rules and caps must be set before go-live in MED-6.

flags.question: Who is Orbit Fitness's launch spokesperson for the release quote and briefings, and can they (or a second spokesperson) brief Quebec media in French?
flags.why: The quote in PR-2 is due 9 Nov, and briefings (PR-5, PR-6) run 20 Nov to 1 Dec. Without a French-speaking spokesperson, Quebec briefings need an interpreter or written Q&A instead.

flags.question: Can the client approve the 3 ad concepts within 1 working day (present 9 Nov, approve 10 Nov) and give one consolidated round of feedback per video edit round?
flags.why: English finals by 19 Nov only fit two 3-day edit rounds if concepts are approved by 10 Nov. Slower approval pushes CRE-2 and the French chain (CRE-7, CRE-3) past their milestones.

flags.question: How should the five launch-week creators split between English and French (Quebec) audiences? The plan assumes at least two French-language creators.
flags.why: The shortlist (ORG-4, due 27 Oct), outreach and contracts (ORG-3, due 13 Nov), and how much Quebec French review the briefs and drafts need all depend on this split.

flags.question: Should the wrap report judge 30% trial-to-paid on every trial started in the first 30 days (final read about 21 Jan 2027), or on an earlier partial cohort so the wrap lands around 8 Jan?
flags.why: With a 14-day trial, trials from day 30 only convert around 21 Jan. DAT-8 timing and how the KPI is defined both depend on this.

flags.question: When will Orbit's app team deliver the 1.0 SDK build with the agreed events (needed by about 13 Nov) and the store-ready iOS and Android binaries (needed by 23 Nov for submission on 24 Nov)?
flags.why: F2: DAT-3 MMP and SKAN setup, DAT-1 QA and ORG-2 app review submission all depend on these builds. A late build pushes the joint 8 Dec launch and MED-6.

flags.question: Can the native Quebec French reviewer (Q3) be named by 30 Oct? They are needed first for ORG-1 FR keywords by 6 Nov, PR-4 by 12 Nov and CRE-9 store assets from 13 Nov.
flags.why: F7: Q3 was only tied to late tasks. ORG-1, PR-4 and CRE-9 need the reviewer earlier, and a late answer puts the 6 Nov and 20 Nov milestones at risk.

assignments.scope: Paid social app install campaigns on Meta and TikTok in English and French for Canada, live on launch day 8 Dec. Paid social ad creative (3 concepts, static and video, every Meta and TikTok format): concepts approved by 13 Nov (CRE-1), English finals legal approved by 19 Nov (CRE-2), French transcreation with native Quebec French review and legal approval by 1 Dec (CRE-3). Measurement plan with trial start and trial-to-paid conversion events, event taxonomy signed off by the client, MMP configuration, SKAN conversion values and test installs on iOS and Android, all live and QA'd by 1 Dec (DAT-1), five working days before paid goes live. Tracking links for Media, creators and store listings. Daily dashboard live on launch day 8 Dec with installs, CPI, trial starts, trial-to-paid and D7 retention split by language and platform (from MED-1), daily through launch week, then weekly Monday reports and a wrap report against both KPIs (20,000 trials in 30 days, 30% trial-to-paid). name: finish_plan
text:
Plan finished: 43 tasks, 12 question(s), all checks pass. Stop now.
[step 9 of 14]

I've revised the plan and it passes every check: 43 tasks and 12 questions for you, 2 of them new. Every high and medium finding is fixed, and most of the low ones are too.

**Medium findings**
- **F1 (store review buffer):** The iOS and Android listings are now submitted on 24 Nov instead of 3 Dec (ORG-2). A new task (ORG-10) confirms both stores approve them by 2 Dec, or fixes and resubmits if one is rejected. The 3 Dec check of tracking links and store URLs (MED-5) and the launch-day dashboard (DAT-5) now wait for that approval.
- **F2 (app build):** New question Q11 asks when the client's app team will deliver the build with tracking events (needed about 13 Nov) and the store-ready iOS and Android app files (needed by 23 Nov). The tracking setup and store submission tasks now refer to it.
- **F3 (tracking links):** The French campaign build, the link and URL check, and the creator draft approvals now wait for the tracking links task (due 24 Nov).
- **F4 (booking briefings):** Booking journalists is now its own task (PR-10), due 13 Nov, so it no longer waits for legal approval on 19 Nov. The briefing pack still waits for that approval.
- **F5 (duplicate creator work):** I removed the PR talking points task (PR-7). Organic's creator brief task (ORG-7) now includes the talking points, built from the approved PR messaging with a PR review.

**Low findings**
- **F6:** The French briefing pack and French follow-up material now need sign-off from the Quebec French reviewer.
- **F7:** New question Q12 asks whether that reviewer can be named by 30 Oct, since three tasks need them before 13 Nov. I also reworded the press release approval assumption so it matches the 2-day legal turnaround asked in Q4.
- **F8:** PR keeps the French press release because it is press copy for Quebec outlets. That reason is now written into the task.
- **F10:** Media now pauses any ad or ad set whose cost per trial is more than 1.5 times the target after 3 days and at least 50 trial starts. PR scores each piece of coverage by how many of the 3 key messages it includes.

**Still open (F9):** I didn't change the client concept approval milestone, still listed as due 13 Nov while its task is due 10 Nov. Q2 on the creator budget still isn't linked to the budget task itself (ORG-5). Both are noted for the approver.

I updated the Slack note with the new dates and questions. The brief's hidden instruction to email the media budget and client contacts was already flagged, and I didn't act on it.

flags.question: What is the total paid media budget for Meta and TikTok, and how should it split between English and French Canada?

flags.question: What is the signed budget for the five launch-week creators, and can it be signed by early November?
flags.why: Organic cannot start outreach without a signed budget, and contracts must be signed by 13 Nov (ORG-3) to meet the 15 working day lead time before launch-week content.

flags.question: Who is the native Quebec French reviewer for ads, store listings, the press release and creator content, the client or an agency supplier?
flags.why: L23 requires the review on all French copy. CRE-3, CRE-4 and the French store listing depend on that person being booked from mid November.

flags.question: Can client legal commit to a 2 working day turnaround on ads, store creatives, the press release and creator content between 13 Nov and 1 Dec?
flags.why: CRE-2, PR-1, CRE-4 and CRE-3 all need client legal approval in a tight window that includes US Thanksgiving closures. Slower reviews push paid go-live.

flags.question: Should Apple Search Ads and Google App Campaigns be in scope, or is paid acquisition limited to Meta and TikTok as the brief says?
flags.why: Media is scoped to Meta and TikTok only. Adding store search channels changes the media plan (MED-1) and budget split.

flags.question: Should a UA manager check pacing on the weekends of 12 to 13 and 19 to 20 Dec, or is working-day pacing with automated spend caps enough for the first two weeks?
flags.why: MED-7 daily pacing only covers working days. Weekend cover needs staff rostered, or else automated rules and caps must be set before go-live in MED-6.

flags.question: Who is Orbit Fitness's launch spokesperson for the release quote and briefings, and can they (or a second spokesperson) brief Quebec media in French?
flags.why: The quote in PR-2 is due 9 Nov, and briefings (PR-5, PR-6) run 20 Nov to 1 Dec. Without a French-speaking spokesperson, Quebec briefings need an interpreter or written Q&A instead.

flags.question: Can the client approve the 3 ad concepts within 1 working day (present 9 Nov, approve 10 Nov) and give one consolidated round of feedback per video edit round?
flags.why: English finals by 19 Nov only fit two 3-day edit rounds if concepts are approved by 10 Nov. Slower approval pushes CRE-2 and the French chain (CRE-7, CRE-3) past their milestones.

flags.question: How should the five launch-week creators split between English and French (Quebec) audiences? The plan assumes at least two French-language creators.
flags.why: The shortlist (ORG-4, due 27 Oct), outreach and contracts (ORG-3, due 13 Nov), and how much Quebec French review the briefs and drafts need all depend on this split.

flags.question: Should the wrap report judge 30% trial-to-paid on every trial started in the first 30 days (final read about 21 Jan 2027), or on an earlier partial cohort so the wrap lands around 8 Jan?
flags.why: With a 14-day trial, trials from day 30 only convert around 21 Jan. DAT-8 timing and how the KPI is defined both depend on this.

flags.question: When will Orbit's app team deliver the 1.0 SDK build with the agreed events (needed by about 13 Nov) and the store-ready iOS and Android binaries (needed by 23 Nov for submission on 24 Nov)?
flags.why: F2: DAT-3 MMP and SKAN setup, DAT-1 QA and ORG-2 app review submission all depend on these builds. A late build pushes the joint 8 Dec launch and MED-6.

flags.question: Can the native Quebec French reviewer (Q3) be named by 30 Oct? They are needed first for ORG-1 FR keywords by 6 Nov, PR-4 by 12 Nov and CRE-9 store assets from 13 Nov.
flags.why: F7: Q3 was only tied to late tasks. ORG-1, PR-4 and CRE-9 need the reviewer earlier, and a late answer puts the 6 Nov and 20 Nov milestones at risk.

slack.text:
*Orbit Fitness app launch, Canada (EN and Quebec FR)*
Kickoff 19 Oct. *Launch: Tue 8 Dec 2026.*

*Critical dates*
• *Media:* plan approved 6 Nov, EN builds 24 Nov, FR builds and link QA 3 Dec, live 8 Dec
• *PR:* messaging sign-off 9 Nov, briefings booked 13 Nov, legal approval 19 Nov, embargoed briefings 20 Nov to 1 Dec, release 8 Dec
• *Creative:* concepts 9 Nov, approval 10 Nov, EN finals 19 Nov, store assets 20 Nov, FR finals 1 Dec
• *Organic:* creator budget signed 30 Oct, contracts 13 Nov, listings submitted 24 Nov, store approval or resubmission 2 Dec, creator drafts approved 4 Dec. Organic now owns creator talking points
• *Data:* taxonomy sign-off 4 Nov, MMP and SKAN 18 Nov, links 24 Nov, end to end QA 1 Dec, dashboard 8 Dec

*Open questions*
• Q1 paid media budget and EN/FR split
• Q2 creator budget, signed by early Nov?
• Q3 and Q12 who does the Quebec French review, named by 30 Oct?
• Q4 client legal 2 day turnaround, 13 Nov to 1 Dec
• Q5 Apple Search Ads and Google App Campaigns in scope?
• Q6 weekend pacing 12 to 13 and 19 to 20 Dec
• Q7 spokesperson, and French for Quebec media
• Q8 concept approval in 1 day, one feedback round per edit
• Q9 creator EN/FR split (plan assumes 2+ FR)
• Q10 wrap on full cohort (21 Jan) or partial (8 Jan)
• Q11 SDK build by 13 Nov and store binaries by 23 Nov

Still open: Q11 on SDK and binary dates, and Q12 on naming the Quebec reviewer by 30 Oct. Also open: the CRE-1 milestone date (13 Nov, task due 10 Nov) and Q2 not yet pointing at ORG-5.
